source_contract.retrieval: All four afternoon FROGs, exact measured-spectrum constraint, source phase degrees 2 through 4 plus removed unobservable affine phase; shared six-coefficient spectral instrument response.
source_contract.selection: Low-complexity single-main-peak hypothesis chosen at user request; no time-waveform penalty or amplifier data in objective. Larger FROG residual than flexible phase model.
source_contract.normalization: sum(abs(field_omega)**2)=1 on uniform omega grid; relative field, source energy must be set separately
source_contract.fft_convention: E(t) proportional to sum E(omega) exp(-i*(omega-omega0)*t); centered forward FFT

source_contract.phase_reliable_interval_policy: Polynomial in the original joint model coordinate over 0.1%-99.9% spectral-energy limits; constant polynomial extension outside, followed by affine gauge removal.
source_contract.F164_zero_added_material_status: assumption based on absence of an insert note; not independently verified

setup_provenance.recording_scope: Detailed longitudinal scalars plus native instantaneous intensity at every crystal face, at local power peak and fixed entrance peak time; no complex-field or adaptive-substep snapshots.
setup_provenance.seed_update_scope: Accepted 1024-point complex FROG field preserved; computational FFT/gain bins 512; spatial grid changes described in grid_change_scope.

material.n2_m2_W.citation: G. N. Patwardhan et al., Opt. Lett. 46, 1824-1827 (2021), DOI 10.1364/OL.421469; measured 47.8 +/- 5 x 10^-20 m^2/W for polycrystalline ZnS at 2.3 um. This is a host baseline, not calibration of the active Cr:ZnS sample.

rate_system.reason: The imported 4I11/2, 4F3/2 and 4F5/2 labels describe an Nd-like rate system and are incompatible with Cr2+:ZnS 5E/5T2 spectroscopy.
rate_system.action_required: Re-import and independently validate the original Cr2+:ZnS source before enabling any proprietary rate-line network.

warnings: The imported proprietary rate-line network was quarantined because its Nd-like level labels are incompatible with Cr2+:ZnS. Only independently configured scalar/runtime LevelSystem parameters are active.

The Commercial App XML n2 value 8.4e-19 m^2/W has no embedded citation or sample-calibration record and placed this operating point above the bulk self-focusing screen. This configuration uses the published 2.3 um polycrystalline ZnS host baseline 4.78e-19 m^2/W; it remains non-quantitative until the actual Cr:ZnS sample is calibrated.

pump_quantum_efficiency=0.73 is a user-requested modelling assumption propagated to the active rate equations and applied material snapshot. It is not independent evidence that the source fluorescence-yield surrogate is identical to pump-excitation quantum efficiency.
The material record contains an effective fluorescence wavelength but no explicit enabled flag; it was retained as metadata and disabled for heating until explicitly enabled.

extras.coherent_substep_note: The dispersion phase cap uses the UI-supported upper limit of 2 rad. Gain and Kerr retain their stricter adaptive limits over the power-carrying spectrum.

znse_prechirper.dispersion_source: Connolly 1979 CVD ZnSe data, Tatian 1984 Sellmeier fit; 23 C
znse_prechirper.thickness_edit_policy: Full original 15 mm table multiplied by 15/15; source phase remains separate.
znse_prechirper.stretcher_coefficients_status: Zero; the full table already includes the ZnSe phase once.
znse_prechirper.material_model_assumption: Wide-band room-temperature CVD ZnSe reference; not a calibration of the actual plate. No absorption/coating/thermal correction is added.

legacy_oscillator_spectrum_replaced.digitization_limit: Rasterized logarithmic publication curve; obscured portions were interpolated and values below the visible floor were set to zero.

oscillator_frog_source.role: Four afternoon oscillator SHG-FROG scans jointly retrieved with a soft measured-spectrum constraint
oscillator_frog_source.spectral_amplitude_reference: Measured background-subtracted spectrum is a SOFT reference (alpha=1), not fixed. The embedded amplitude is the selected joint reconstruction, including its 2.0915% overall spectral adjustment.
oscillator_frog_source.phase_reference: Selected 20-control smooth-phase afternoon four-trace joint fit. Preserve the archived complex spectral phase; no conjugation, no imposed target duration.
oscillator_frog_source.phase_ambiguity: Conditional joint working field; branch depends on plate assignments and baseline assumption. Not a uniquely measured oscillator-exit phase.
oscillator_frog_source.measurement_pairing: Same testbed parent folder; exact acquisition time and optical-state matching of independent spectrum remain unconfirmed.
oscillator_frog_source.preprocessing: Each SHG wavelength column: subtract median of first/last 37 delay samples, clip nonnegative and threshold at 0.3% of global peak; correct S_omega proportional to S_lambda lambda^2 and interpolate onto common frequency grid. No 2D Gaussian smoothing.
oscillator_frog_source.retrieval_response_scope: Response belongs to the FROG measurement model only; it is not multiplied into this seed amplitude.
oscillator_frog_source.sampling_policy: Preserve every native retrieved complex-field sample and the original zero guard; interpolate to 512 transport/gain bins at the original frequency span. Exploratory candidate: input temporal-boundary contract FAILS; thresholds are unchanged. Original 1024-point retrieval is not replaced or refitted.
oscillator_frog_source.gain_grid_policy: No gain-frequency grouping, matching the original configuration policy.
oscillator_frog_source.power_normalization: Field normalized by the engine to the supplied 22 nJ; the relative FROG retrieval does not supply absolute energy.
oscillator_frog_source.material_cross_section_range_note: 0.069965% of native source energy lies outside the inherited 1600-3000 nm gain-table interval; the amplitude is retained.
oscillator_frog_source.znse_phase_contract: Source complex field is before ZnSe; the separate full 15 mm phase is applied once through seed.coherent.spectral_phase. Stretcher GD/GDD/TOD/FOD are zero.

measurements.added_material: no extra plate documented; baseline assumption

oscillator_frog_source.raw_shape_scope: Each of four raw scans is 374 delay samples by 1024 wavelength samples; fit band 1000-1300 nm SHG.
oscillator_frog_source.retrieval_trace_metric: RMS of four relative L2 residuals evaluated on original wavelength coordinates after background/threshold processing.
